name: hero-block
description: The hero of a dashboard page: the page title in the serif display face, one row of text-button actions and one centred search field, stacked in a centred column.

props.name: title
props.description: Page title. The first word is the emphasised run (bold italic), the rest the plain run (italic).

props.name: actions
props.default: Load new opportunities, Show Analysed, Updates (2 new), Go to the last activity
props.description: Labels of the text-buttons in the row (secondary, dotted).

props.name: search_placeholder
props.default: Smart search by statuses, deadlines, keywords, context...

rationale: Fixed 400px high (maintainer, 2026-10-11; Figma is 320px), the search field at the bottom, title and actions centred in the space above it. Otherwise read off Figma auto-layout: 40px top, 10px sides, 20px below the search field (maintainer 2026-10-11; Figma has 40px), 60px between the actions and the field, 20px between rows, the title row 20px above its text and none below (maintainer, 2026-10-11; Figma has 20px), 800px search field. The title uses the new display type roles (Libre Bodoni, Bold Italic then Italic, 40px); the face is self-hosted (fonts/libre-bodoni.css, scripts/fetch_fonts.py, SIL OFL), the stack falls back to Didot / Georgia / serif while it loads. The actions are existing text-buttons (secondary, dotted: they stay on the page) and the search is the transparent input, so no new interactive look is introduced. Figma draws the action row at 50% opacity; that is treated as a Figma artifact and not reproduced (maintainer, 2026-10-11). Staged in local-components until the maintainer confirms it goes into dis-system.
a11y_notes: The title is an h1. Actions are real buttons with visible labels. The search input has aria-label 'Smart search' because its placeholder is not a label.
